verdict.rationale: An official on-device inference runtime is a fair axis for a 3D/game engine library, but nothing in the evidence shows three.js shipping one. WebGPU compute shaders and TSL are only developer building blocks a developer could use to construct inference, not an inference runtime, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can run ML models inside the game — an official inference runtime for on-device model execution
